campaign.target: sc-composer-beads subprocess execution and argv boundaries
campaign.provenance_note: The original campaign sprint document and report package were not committed. This package reconstructs durable evidence from the promoted regression tests and their source comments at commit 12cfef8; it is not an original worker transcript.

summary.description: Two promoted 20260817-2 findings document subprocess argv attribution and descendant output-pipe containment.

workers.fuzz_run_description: Embedded NUL in Beads variable value is attributed to an unavailable executable
workers.context_text: Post-hoc reconstruction from the promoted test and its 20260817-2 source comment. A valid UTF-8 value containing U+0000 poisons argv construction before the configured executable can start.

test_inputs.description: Run Validate with `/bin/echo` and bead variable `payload=legit\u0000withnul`.
test_inputs.outcome: FAIL: OS argv construction rejects the NUL, but the receipt code is BEADS_BD_UNAVAILABLE.

findings.minimal_template: valid formula template; no template defect required
findings.expected_oracle: An invalid Beads variable value is rejected before spawn or receives a cause-specific argv-construction diagnostic.
findings.observed_result: `Command::spawn` returns InvalidInput for an interior NUL and the stage maps it to BEADS_BD_UNAVAILABLE.
findings.requirement_trace: ADR-0021 defines BEADS_BD_UNAVAILABLE as inability to start the configured executable.
findings.requirement_follow_up: No new ADR is needed; validate variable values before spawn or add a distinct stable argv-construction code.
findings.root_cause: Only Beads variable keys are validated; values reach `Command::args` unchecked and the generic I/O mapping erases the cause.
findings.recommended_fix: Reject control bytes in Beads variable values before process creation, or map argv construction errors separately.

workers.fuzz_run_description: Output limit terminates a descendant holding the inherited pipe open
workers.context_text: Post-hoc reconstruction from the promoted test and its 20260817-2 source comment. The test was later replaced by the cross-platform process-tree regression after the production fix.

test_inputs.description: A shell starts `( sleep 1 ) &` then floods stdout past the cap, leaving the descendant with the inherited stdout descriptor.
test_inputs.minimal_input: #!/bin/sh; ( sleep 1 ) &; while :; do printf X; done
test_inputs.outcome: FAIL: killing only the direct child leaves the reader blocked until the descendant exits.

findings.minimal_input: background descendant inherits stdout, direct child floods past the 64 KiB cap
findings.expected_oracle: An over-limit command terminates every descendant holding captured output pipes and returns promptly.
findings.observed_result: The original runner killed only the direct PID, so the pipe remained open until the orphaned descendant exited.
findings.requirement_trace: ADR-0021 requires bounded captured stdout/stderr and termination after an output cap breach.
findings.requirement_follow_up: No new ADR is needed; the production fix must retain process-tree termination on Unix and Job Object containment on Windows.
findings.root_cause: Direct-child-only termination did not close inherited pipe descriptors held by descendants.
findings.recommended_fix: Terminate the process group on Unix and the assigned Job Object on Windows, with a regression proving prompt return.
